title: Speaking Practice 13 - Describe a Place You Want to Visit
description: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Describe a place you would like to visit in the future.

stimuli.title: Part 2: Describe a Place You Want to Visit
stimuli.content:
You will have 1 minute to prepare and then speak for 1-2 minutes.

Describe a place you would like to visit in the future.

You should say: where it is, how you learned about it, what you would do there, and explain why you want to visit this place.

questionGroups.instruction: Speak for 1-2 minutes using the prompts.

questions.content: Describe a place you would like to visit in the future.

explanation.sampleAnswer: I have always dreamed of visiting Japan, particularly Kyoto. I learned about it through anime and travel documentaries. I would love to visit the ancient temples, try authentic Japanese cuisine, and experience the cherry blossom season. The combination of traditional culture and modern technology fascinates me.
explanation.tips: Cover all prompts: where, how you learned, what you would do, why

questions.content: Do you think travelling is educational?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Absolutely. Travelling exposes you to different cultures, languages, and perspectives that you simply cannot get from books or the internet.

questions.content: Is it better to travel domestically or internationally?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Both have value. Domestic travel helps you appreciate your own country, while international travel broadens your worldview.
